decisionRecordGate.title: [DEC-STK-001] Lap Decision Record ve mo hinh kiem ke A
decisionRecordGate.note: DEC-NO-STOCKTAKE-001 must not be cited as an approved standalone Decision ID while WWHN-25 is In Progress. That does not weaken the guard: the controlling requirement REQ-SRS-037 already lives in the adopted SRS/FRD v1.12 baseline and is corroborated by the ERD and wireframe baselines.
decisionRecordGate.closureEvidence: Approver-authored disposition on WWHN-25 naming the exact artifact revision/hash.

runtimeRule.currentBehavior: No Stocktake Session/Snapshot/Count/Variance surface, no stocktake.* permission, no route/menu, no direct stock-edit endpoint, and no Stocktake element in the current FE/BE handover contract set (Postman, focused OpenAPI, permission catalog, FE contract baseline).
runtimeRule.guardPurpose: Regression guard: keep FE/BE source consistent with REQ-SRS-037 and the ERD/wireframe baselines so a stale historical artifact cannot silently reintroduce a removed surface. It is not a claim of standalone Decision Record approval.
runtimeRule.reintroductionGate: Approved Later Phase / Change Request / closed WWHN-25 Decision Record, plus synchronized FE/BE/OpenAPI/RBAC/test updates.

scopeDisposition.conflict: Ticket WWHN-237 (và nhánh WWHN-60) yêu cầu Stocktake/Variance, trong khi REQ-SRS-037 của baseline đang hiệu lực cấm capability đó.
scopeDisposition.resolutionMeaning: WWHN-237 đóng dưới dạng removal/deprecation closure: không viết code Stocktake/Variance; thay vào đó chứng minh absence trên toàn bộ surface FE/BE và gỡ tàn dư trong bộ contract bàn giao.
scopeDisposition.effectiveFrom: Ngày WWHN-334 chuyển DONE (SRS §0.1 — không có effective date hồi tố). Áp dụng cho mọi deployment v1.12 trở đi.
scopeDisposition.reintroductionGate: Chỉ mở lại khi có Later Phase/Change Request được duyệt hoặc WWHN-25 (DEC-STK-001) đóng, kèm cập nhật đồng bộ FE/BE/OpenAPI/RBAC/test.
scopeDisposition.approvalOwner: BA Main + PM/PO (ghi trên WWHN-237); DEV/QA không tự duyệt phạm vi.
